Jonathan Apple Crisp
By: Anonymous
Published: Saturday, December 5, 2009 - 11:13pm

Ingredients




8 mediums Jonathan apples, peeled and sliced
2 tablespoons Lemon juice ⅓ C butter or 3/4 cup Brown sugar, packed ½ c all purpose flour
1/2 cup Quick rolled oats ½ tsp cinnamon





Preparation

1 Place peeled apples in lemon juice in 8" glass baking dish. In a bowl, combine remaining ingredients with a fork until crumbly. Sprinkle over apples. Microwave unovered 10-12 minutes or until apples are tender.
